Name: aim1k tablet
_comment: NO PLUGIN DLL REQUIRED. The firmware's report layout is byte-for-byte what
OTD's built-in TabletReportParser expects: [0] report id, [1] buttons,
[2:4] X u16 LE, [4:6] Y u16 LE, [6:8] pressure u16 LE. The in-range flag is
deliberately on bit 0 of byte 1, because that parser reads bits 1 and 2 as
the pen buttons - putting in-range on bit 1 would look like a button held
down the whole time the pen is over the tablet.
InputReportLength 8 selects the VENDOR collection; the absolute-mouse
collection on the same interface is 6 bytes and Windows owns it.
FeatureInitReport [[3, 0]] is report ID 3 (REPORT_ID_MODE) with payload 0,
which switches the tablet's absolute-mouse collection OFF when OTD takes
over. Without it the tablet keeps moving the cursor by itself and fights
OTD for the pointer. Unplugging and replugging restores mouse mode, so the
tablet still works driverless on any other machine.
Coordinates are in 0.01 mm: MaxX 11000 over Width 110 mm.
